data.name: Bhavyata
data.long_meaning: Bhavyata is derived from the Sanskrit word Bhavya, which means ‘developed’, ‘progressive’, or ‘prosperous’. In Hindu mythology, Bhavyata is the name of the goddess of prosperity and progress. She is believed to bring wealth, success, and good fortune to those who worship her.
